subject: MAP kickoff: evidence owners, data handling POCs, and evaluation readiness
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Cleary <jordan.c@heliostx.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: evidence owners, data handling POCs, and evaluation readiness

Hi Jordan — thanks for agreeing to run this evaluation with us. Attaching a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and our SOC 2 questionnaire to help kick things off. High-level goals: get HelioSTX mapped to the SOC 2 evidence roster, confirm data handling owners, and complete an evaluation pass so we can finalize the pilot contract within the next 6 weeks.

Quick ask / proposed next steps:
- Confirm primary security/compliance contact and data handling POC on your side (see timeline below)
- Verify whether HelioSTX can share architecture diagrams and retention policies (we'll use these for the evidence mapping)
- Weekly 30-minute sync (proposed cadence: Thursdays 10:00–10:30 PT, starting 9/16)
- Target: evidence completeness and evaluation artifacts delivered by 10/26 (6 weeks)

Roles I've proposed in the attached MAP (editable):
- MAP owner (Redwood): Maya Srinivasan — overall program lead / sync owner
- SOC 2 evidence owner (Redwood): Neha Kapoor — evidence collection, attestations, and questionnaire tracking
- Technical evidence lead (Redwood): Vivek Kulkarni — architecture, logging, data flows, and controls mapping
- HelioSTX security lead (external): please confirm — mapped to SOC 2 control owners
- HelioSTX data handling POC (external): please confirm — retention, deletion, and access reviews

Attachments: redwood-heliox-MAP-v0.1.xlsx (MAP with timeline and owners), redwood-soc2-questionnaire.pdf

If that schedule works we’ll send a calendar invite for Thursday and drop an editable MAP in the Drive (link below). Appreciate a 1–2 line confirmation of your primary contacts so we can lock owners.

Drive (read/write): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cREDWOOD-HELIO-MAP
HubSpot: deal RDW-3201

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

—
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Product Manager, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com
From: Jordan Cleary <jordan.c@heliostx.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@heliostx.com>, security_ops@heliostx.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: evidence owners, data handling POCs, and evaluation readiness

Maya — thanks for the clear plan and the MAP. Quick responses below and a couple of asks from our side.

Confirmed HelioSTX contacts:
- Security lead: Priya Rao <priya.rao@heliostx.com> (she owns SOC 2 evidence and vendor assessments)
- Data handling POC: security_ops@heliostx.com (team mailbox; best for retention/deletion questions)

We can share high-level architecture diagrams and retention summaries; some of the deeper logs will need a signed NDA/PIA addendum — happy to start with summaries and add a more detailed artifact exchange once we have an agreed scope.

One item for the MAP: for the evidence delivery date can we get a mid-point checkpoint at 3 weeks (9/30) to confirm gaps? That will help us prioritize what we can share before the final delivery.

Thanks — Jordan

- Redwood evidence owners (mapped in spreadsheet):
  • System diagrams & network controls: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek@redwood.com)
  • Logging & retention summaries: Grace O'Connor (grace@redwood.com)
  • Access control attestation: Neha Kapoor (neha@redwood.com)

- We can provide: high-level architecture PNG/PDF, retention policy excerpt, sample audit log schema (redacted)
- We request: evidence delivery format preferably as a single zipped folder per control area (naming: HELIO-STX_CONTROLNAME_YYYYMMDD.zip)

Action items for HelioSTX: please add Priya and security_ops@heliostx.com as editors on the Drive folder so we can co-edit the MAP and place evidence artifacts in the right lanes.

Link to templates (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cREDWOOD-HELIO-MAP

Jordan / Priya — thanks, that is helpful. Calendar invite sent for Thursdays 10:00–10:30 PT starting 9/16 (recurring) — please accept if that works.

Two quick confirmations before our first sync:
1) Mid-point checkpoint: we’ll aim for 9/30 as a gap review (agree)
2) Drive access: Priya and security_ops@heliostx.com are now editors on the MAP folder; please upload any artifacts to the Evidence > HelioSTX folder using the naming guidance Vivek shared.

If you can drop a short one-pager for retention policy in the next 72 hours, that helps us prioritize the control buckets for the first pass. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the summaries you mentioned and call out items that need a formal addendum.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.
